atoms.b: Enzo the starfish likes to cook. Captain Benny needs a cook for his ship. Enzo becomes the ship’s cook.
atoms.sound: ssml: Enzo the starfish likes to cook. <break time='600ms'/> Captain Benny needs a cook for his ship. <break time='600ms'/> Enzo becomes the ships cook.

instruction.text: Listen to the sounds. Which event in the story happened at the beginning?

b.sound: Benny needs a cook for his ship.

atoms.b: Benny gets hungry. Enzo cooks his first meal. He serves seaweed soup.
atoms.sound: ssml: Benny gets hungry. <break time='600ms'/> Enzo cooks his first meal. <break time='600ms'/> He serves seaweed soup.

instruction.text: Listen to the sounds. Which event in the story happened in the middle?

atoms.b: Benny does not like the seaweed soup. Enzo feels bad. Benny tells Enzo that he does not like seaweed.
atoms.sound: ssml: Benny does not like the seaweed soup. <break time='600ms'/> Enzo feels bad. <break time='600ms'/> Benny tells Enzo that he does not like seaweed.

instruction.text: Listen to the sounds. Which event in the story happened at the beginning?

b.sound: Enzo feels bad that Benny doesn’t like his soup.

atoms.b: Enzo does not make soup with seaweed any more. Now Benny loves Enzo’s soups. They eat soup every week!
atoms.sound: ssml: Enzo does not make soup with seaweed any more. <break time='600ms'/> Now Benny loves Enzos soups! <break time='600ms'/> They eat soup every week.

instruction.text: Listen to the sounds. Which event in the story happened at the end?

b.sound: Enzo does not use seaweed any more.
Benny and Enzo eat soup together every week.
